Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Owns the bounds of a built-in or explicitly mapped PostgreSQL range. A null reference is SQL NULL; a parameterless instance is empty.
Construction retains the requested bounds. PostgreSQL validates and canonicalizes them on datum conversion.

```csharp
public sealed class PgRange<T> : IEquatable<PgRange<T>> where T : struct
```

Type parameters:

`T`

A supported built-in bound or a closed value type declaring both PgDatumType and PgRangeType.

Inheritance: [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object)

Implements: [IEquatable&lt;PgRange&lt;T&gt;&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.iequatable-1)

### PgRange(T?, T?, bool, bool)

Creates a bounded or unbounded range without backend access. Null bounds mean unbounded ends.

```csharp
public PgRange(T? lower, T? upper, bool lowerInclusive = true, bool upperInclusive = false)
```

Parameters:

`lower` — <code>T?</code>

The lower value, or null for an unbounded end.

`upper` — <code>T?</code>

The upper value, or null for an unbounded end.

`lowerInclusive` — [bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)

Whether the lower value is included; ignored when unbounded.

`upperInclusive` — [bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)

Whether the upper value is included; ignored when unbounded.
